read.thesis: Tenet raised 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance by $295M at midpoint to $4.83–5.03B on hospital margin gains (18%) and USPI volume mix, but exchange revenues fell 17% and guidance assumes that drag persists in H2.

capex.quote: we're a bit more cautious on large-scale hospital builds until we understand market environment and expansion opportunities there

triggers.label: Adj EBITDA guide raised $295M at midpoint
triggers.quote: we are raising our full year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to a range of $4.83 billion to $5.03 billion
triggers.highlight: raising our full year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance

triggers.label: Exchange revenues down 17% YoY
triggers.quote: exchange revenues have declined a significant 17% compared to second quarter of 2025

triggers.label: Same-hospital admissions +2.6%
triggers.quote: Same-hospital inpatient adjusted admissions rose 2.6% in the quarter

guidance.quote: we are raising our full year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to a range of $4.83 billion to $5.03 billion
we now expect consolidated net operating revenues in the range of $21.9 billion to $22.5 billion
we now expect adjusted free cash flow after NCI in the range of $1.825 billion to $2.055 billion
we now expect to exceed $300 million in full year M&A spend in 2026
we now expect a contribution of $140 million from recently approved increases in certain supplemental Medicaid programs

red_flags.label: Out-of-period Medicaid revenue inflates quarter
red_flags.quote: we recognized $92 million of favorable out-of-period supplemental Medicaid revenues related to prior years in the second quarter

red_flags.label: Exchange-to-uninsured conversion ~1:1
red_flags.quote: we are roughly seeing a pretty consistent conversion from exchange patient volume into uninsured on a pretty much one-to-one basis

evasions.quote: In terms of forecasting out what that implication is for Medicaid revenue growth going forward, I'll be honest, I'm not going to do that today
I really don't want to guess about exchange enrollment in the following year
So there's a lot of moving pieces here that we're still looking at
